label: Your Project, Your Way
title:
Fully configurable.
Open source.
subtitle: Upload reference docs, set default resource requirements, and pick a default agent — each project has its own settings for infrastructure and agent configuration.
summary: Upload reference docs, set default resource requirements, and pick a default agent per project.
highlights: Upload reference docs and organize them with folders and tags
Markdown renders inline, including Mermaid diagrams
Set default resource requirements (vCPU, memory, disk) and a default agent per project
Per-agent credential overrides configure API keys at the project level

details.headline: Project library
details.body: Upload architecture docs, research, and reference material. Files are organized with folders and tags. Agents can access library files as additional context during their work.

screenshot.alt: Project Library showing research and runbooks folders, five markdown and PDF files tagged architecture, ledger, compliance, and runbooks, a Newest sort control, search, and an Upload button
screenshot.caption: Folders, tags, and upload — agents can pull files from the library as context

details.headline: Built-in document viewer
details.body: Markdown files render with full formatting, including Mermaid diagrams. Toggle between the rendered view and raw source, or download the file directly.

screenshot.alt: File preview modal rendering ledger-migration-plan.md with a Mermaid flowchart and Rendered, Source, Download, and Comments controls
screenshot.caption: Rendered markdown with Mermaid diagram support — view source or download

details.headline: Agent defaults and overrides
details.body: Pick a default agent type for the project, then override credentials and model per agent at the project level — settings fall through to your user-level configuration when left empty. Default resource requirements (vCPU, memory, disk) live on the Infrastructure tab alongside the compute pool.

screenshot.alt: Project Settings Agents tab showing six agent types with Claude Code selected as the default and an Agent Overrides section with a project-level API key and model override
screenshot.caption: A default agent type and per-agent credential and model overrides, per project
